note: THE BOOK-CITES-NO-REGISTRY-IDS CHECK CANNOT SEE SLUG IDS, AND SLUGS ARE THE ONLY KIND NEW ROWS MAY USE. docs_consistency has a test named the_book_carries_no_registry_ids_or_process_vocabulary, enforcing that only the Frontier part may cite the registry. It is implemented by find_registry_id in cli/tests/suite/docs_consistency.rs, which requires an ASCII DIGIT immediately after the prefix -- so it matches the 403 grandfathered numbered IDs (CLIENT-12 shape) and matches NOTHING with a slug ID (CLIENT-snapshot-chart-cannot-zoom shape), which decision 0026 makes the only permitted form for new rows. Found by writing a chronicle that cited a slug ID: the check went green and the prose still violated the documented rule. Consequence for anyone writing a chronicle or retrospective right now: a green docs_consistency is NOT evidence your DoD prose is clean of registry IDs -- grep your own file. The check gets weaker every time the registry grows while continuing to read as total. Registered as PROC-registry-id-ban-cannot-see-slugs.
